This Mfa Is Filed Under Section 74(1) Of
Right To Fair Copensation And Transparency
In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And
Resettlement Act, 2013, Praying To Modify The
Judgment And Award Dated 22/12/2021 Passed
By The Learned I Additional District Judge And
Additional Land Acquisition Rehabilitation And
Resettlement Authority, Vijapur, In Lac No.
738/2020 And To Enhance The Compensation
Rs.10,80,000/- Per Acre Instead Of Rs.7,56,000/-
Per Acre.

This Appeal, Coming On For Orders, This
Day, B.M. Shyam Prasad, J., Delivered The
Following:
 Judgment

On 30.05.2023, a final opportunity is granted to comply with the office objections observing that if there is failure to comply with the office objections, the appeal must be listed for necessary orders of dismissal.
Despite this final opportunity, the office objections have not been attended to and none appears for the appellants.
It is obvious that the concerned are not interested in prosecuting the appeal and therefore the appeal stands dismissed for default.
